headline: LOO eval on 47 K562/hESC paired deltas: raw transfer cosine is only ~0.13 — context transfer is fundamentally weak; low-rank map lifts sign accuracy to 0.60 but destroys magnitude (deP 0.10); fitted scalar s=0.44 says hESC deltas are WEAKER than K562, opposite the 2026-context direction
hypotheses_preregistered: LOO cosine on the paired set bounds what context transfer can deliver; classes must beat GlobalScalar by >0.05 mean cosine to ship (docs/k012-layer-a-pipeline.md)
interpretation: No class cleared the +0.05-cosine acceptance bar vs the scalar/identity baseline — per the spec this is a publishable negative for naive paired transfer

The fitted scalar s=0.44 means hESC responses are weaker than K562 in this pair set, yet k011 showed the 2026 contexts reward LARGER applied deltas — the 2026 contexts are not hESC-like in magnitude response either
Low-rank's sign-accuracy jump (0.32 -> 0.60) suggests coarse pathway-level direction transfers while fine structure does not — a possible hybrid: keep raw delta but reweight by low-rank agreement
Consistent with the strategy doc: Track 1 pivot to lineage-matched corpora (RPE1 arm for context B) is now the higher-EV Track-1 move
next_steps: Lineage-matched corpus check: score context A/B/C basal profiles against Replogle K562 vs RPE1 control arms; if B matches RPE1, swap the prior source for context B
k011 x2.0 submission brackets the delta-scale optimum
